en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 2.11 percent higher at 22694
en.dek: The Hang Seng Index rose 467 points to close at 22694.77 on Friday, with the Tech Index surging 6.45 percent amid an afternoon rally.
body: Hong Kong stocks closed higher on Friday, with the benchmark Hang Seng Index advancing 467.89 points, or 2.11 percent, to finish at 22694.77. Turnover reached 2571.4 billion Hong Kong dollars.

The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index gained 2.01 percent to 7644.18, while the Hang Seng Tech Index jumped 6.45 percent to 3637.88. Semiconductor and technology shares led the gains, including Hua Hong Semiconductor which rose more than 20 percent and SMIC which climbed over 16 percent.

Meituan advanced more than 8 percent and Alibaba gained about 7 percent. The afternoon session saw a strong lift after reports of supportive mainland policy signals. Analysts noted the rebound followed several days of declines earlier in the week.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收升2.11%報22694點 科指飆6.45%
zh.dek: 恒生指數周五收報22694.77點，升467點或2.11%，恒生科技指數急升6.45%，午後升勢明顯。
body: 港股周五收高，恒生指數上升467.89點，或2.11%，收報22694.77點，成交額2571.4億港元。
恒生中國企業指數升2.01%報7644.18點，恒生科技指數急升6.45%報3637.88點。半導體及科技股領漲，華虹宏力升逾兩成，中芯國際升逾16%。
美團升逾8%，阿里巴巴升約7%。午後大市在內地政策消息帶動下明顯造好。分析指是次反彈是在早前數日下跌後出現。
